# SnackPortal2 Non-Negotiable Constraints

**Baseline:** `origin/main @ 88db1a5` after PR #11
**Generated by:** PRD 03 V4-R16 Phase C Handover Status-Doc Reconciliation Execution

## Mandatory architecture constraints

Physical Multi-Database MVP is mandatory, not future-only.

One Request → One Active Tenant → One Database.

Control DB ≠ Tenant DB.

Tenant DB ≠ Tenant DB.

Gateway ≠ Database Resolution.

Database Router remains the sole DB selector.

Workspace ≠ Routing.

Portal ≠ Routing.

Ownership ≠ Routing.

Frontend ≠ Database Routing.

Authentication ≠ Routing.

Authentication ≠ Authorization.

Authentication ≠ Database Access.

Global Record ≠ Tenant Record.

Import ≠ Synchronization.

No cross-tenant request fan-out.

No shared tenant databases.

No direct Lovable-to-many-database routing.

No direct Supabase/PostgREST business-table access from frontend.

No portal-side database access.

No API Gateway ownership-audit DTO residency binding until the IC-002 ownership-audit-section extension lands.

No vendor lock-in.

No Lovable / Supabase coupling in backend governance.

## DEC-11

DEC-11 remains binding.

The API Gateway must not bind ownership-audit DTO residency until the IC-002 ownership-audit-section extension lands.

## API Gateway constraint

API Gateway implementation has not started.

The Gateway may orchestrate/request-route only according to contracts.

The Gateway must not select tenant databases directly.

Database selection belongs to Database Router.

Tenant active context must be singular per request.

## PRD rejection rule

Reject any PRD that weakens:

- Physical Multi-Database MVP
- DEC-11
- Database Router as sole DB selector
- One Request → One Active Tenant → One Database
- vendor-neutral backend governance
